physical_model: Single-phase one-dimensional inviscid reactive Euler, heptane_lu_88sk with the native PeleC solver. This does not validate empirical WD6 high-temperature chemistry or spray coupling.
time_check: 1200 cells, CFL 0.2 versus 0.1; this is not an independent fine-grid time convergence study.
additional_assessment: Report spatial trends, temporal sensitivity, boundary mass and energy balances and wave-front fit residuals. Targets above do not by themselves establish full asymptotic convergence or exclude physical unsteadiness. Shock peak resolution is reported separately.
